testcases.expected: The landing page displays the exact referral applied and free trial offer message.
preconditions: Referral URL is valid and reachable
steps: Verify that the text of element ReferralOfferMessage is "Referral Code (${referral_code}) Applied • You got 15 days Free trial"
testcases.title: Verify referral code applied and free trial offer message on landing page

testcases.expected: After entering the mobile number and correct OTP fetched from the tool, the business selection page is displayed.
preconditions: Referral landing page loaded with referral code applied
Access to internal OTP fetch tool at ${otp_tool_url} is available
steps: Wait until element OtpInput is displayed
Store the OTP displayed in element ToolOtpDisplay in variable fetched_otp
Verify that element BusinessSelectionPage is displayed
testcases.title: Verify mobile number entry and OTP verification using external OTP tool leads to business selection page

testcases.expected: After selecting the business '${business_name}' and proceeding, the claim your free trial page is displayed.
preconditions: User has completed mobile number and OTP verification
steps: Verify that element ClaimFreeTrialPage is displayed
testcases.title: Verify selecting business and proceeding leads to claim free trial page
